text: Added six Site-enabling low-level capability children (P6f.21-P6f.26): typed scheduler timing, requeue/interruption evidence, pre-deadline signals, explicit epoch-fenced resubmission, hierarchical keys with atomic prefix attachment, and typed atomic file claiming. These are deliberately substrate only; pools, pilots, leases, spools, drain policy, and a scheduler-agnostic SPI remain above scala-slurm.
